# has sequence feature

Links a biological sequence location to a feature annotation on that sequence. Non-functional: a single location may carry multiple features (overlapping genes, nested exons, multiple SNPs).

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasSequenceFeature>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:hasSequenceFeature`  

*object property* · domain `gmeow:BiologicalSequenceLocation` · range `gmeow:SequenceFeature`
